jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Hybrid/Remote Position; must be in one of the following markets: West Palm Beach, Broward County, Boca Raton or Boynton Beach\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: Recruitment and Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


Under the direct supervision of the Director of Human Resources, the Recruitment \& Onboarding Specialist is responsible for coordinating and supporting Pivot, Inc.'s recruitment, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding processes. The position serves as a primary point of contact for applicants, candidates, new employees, hiring managers, and other individuals involved in the recruitment and onboarding process.


The Recruitment \& Onboarding Specialist manages day\-to\-day recruitment activities, including job postings, applicant screening, candidate communications, interview coordination, pre\-employment requirements, new\-hire documentation, orientation, and onboarding activities. This position works closely with the Director of Human Resources, agency Directors, supervisors, and hiring managers to help ensure positions are filled with qualified candidates in an efficient, consistent, professional, and timely manner.


In addition to recruitment and onboarding, this position provides support in employee records, HRIS maintenance, employment verifications, HR documentation, compliance, reporting, audits, employee communications, and other daily Human Resources Department responsibilities.


The Recruitment \& Onboarding Specialist is expected to assist the Director of Human Resources with routine and operational HR functions, allowing the Director to devote greater attention to complex employee relations, compliance, policy development, workforce planning, leadership support, and other strategic human resources initiatives. The Recruitment \& Onboarding Specialist must exemplify the spirit of Pivot, modeling the core values of connection first, relentless compassion, and commitment to never settle.

**Responsibilities**

**Competencies**

* Proactively seeks and finds ways to provide the highest standards of service to employees, supervisors, and organizational partners.
* Possesses or develops the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to effectively administer employee benefits and related HR functions.
* Demonstrates the ability to identify recruitment and onboarding challenges, gather appropriate information, and assist with developing effective solutions.
* Effectively manages job postings, applicant pipelines, interview schedules, pre\-employment requirements, new\-hire activities, deadlines, and multiple open positions.
* Creates and sustains positive working relationships with candidates, employees, leadership, community partners, and other stakeholders.
* Demonstrates open, honest, respectful, and professional written and verbal communication.
* Works collaboratively with hiring managers and Human Resources to support effective staffing and successful integration of new employees.
* Maintains effectiveness in a work environment where staffing needs, schedules, vacancies, and priorities may change.
* Maintains organizational integrity, confidentiality, consistency, and professionalism throughout recruitment and employment processes.
* Productively focuses time and resources on activities that support timely recruitment, hiring, and onboarding.
* Proactively identifies recruitment needs, follows up with candidates and hiring managers, and moves hiring processes forward.

**Essential Duties, Responsibilities and Expectations**

**Recruitment**

* Coordinates recruitment efforts for exempt and nonexempt personnel, students, temporary employees, and other positions as assigned.
* Works with the Director of Human Resources and agency leadership to identify current and anticipated staffing needs.
* Prepares, posts, and maintains approved job openings through appropriate recruitment sources.
* Reviews applications and resumes to identify candidates who meet established position qualifications.
* Conducts initial candidate screenings as assigned and communicates professionally and timely with applicants throughout the recruitment process.
* Coordinates candidate referrals to appropriate Directors, supervisors, and hiring managers.
* Schedules and coordinates interviews between candidates and agency representatives.
* Participates in interviews as appropriate and assists hiring managers with consistent interviewing and candidate evaluation processes.
* Maintains accurate documentation regarding applicants, interviews, candidate status, and hiring decisions.
* Conducts and/or coordinates professional references and other approved pre\-employment inquiries.
* Coordinates required pre\-employment processes, including background investigations, drug screenings, and other requirements applicable to the position.
* Maintains communication with selected candidates regarding pre\-employment requirements and anticipated start dates.
* Prepares and coordinates approved employment offers and related correspondence under the direction of the Director of Human Resources.
* Maintains appropriate communication with candidates who are not selected.
* Develops and maintains relationships with colleges, universities, workforce organizations, community partners, and other potential recruitment sources; participates in recruitment events as appropriate.
* Monitors recruiting activity and assists the Director of Human Resources with identifying difficult\-to\-fill positions, recruitment trends, staffing needs, and improvements to recruitment processes.

**Interview Coordination and Selection Support**

* Serves as the primary Human Resources contact for coordinating candidate interviews.
* Coordinates interview schedules with candidates, Directors, supervisors, and other interview participants.
* Prepares interview materials and candidate information for hiring managers as appropriate.
* Participates in interviews and candidate screening activities as assigned by the Director of Human Resources.
* Assists with developing consistent interview questions and candidate evaluation tools.
* Ensures interview and selection documentation is completed and maintained appropriately.
* Provides hiring managers with administrative and procedural support throughout the selection process.

**Onboarding and New Employee Orientation**

* Coordinates the onboarding process for newly hired employees from acceptance of employment through completion of initial onboarding requirements.
* Serves as a primary point of contact for new employees prior to and during the onboarding process.
* Communicates start dates, reporting information, orientation requirements, required documentation, and other onboarding information to new employees.
* Prepares and distributes new\-hire paperwork and onboarding materials and ensures required documentation is completed accurately and timely.
* Coordinates and conducts portions of new\-employee orientation as assigned.
* Coordinates orientation schedules with Human Resources, agency leadership, program staff, and other appropriate departments.
* Ensures new employees receive required policies, procedures, employment information, organizational materials, and initial training requirements.
* Enters and/or coordinates entry of new employee information into the agency's Human Resources Information System (HRIS).
* **Creates and maintains appropriate new employee personnel documentation and records.**
* Maintains accurate applicant, candidate, and new\-hire information within the agency's HRIS and other approved systems.
* Enters and maintains new employee information as assigned.
* Maintains recruitment, interview, hiring, and onboarding documentation in an accurate, organized, and confidential manner.
* Maintains personnel files and databases according to agency procedures.
* Generates routine recruitment, hiring, onboarding, vacancy, and other HR reports as requested.
* Tracks open positions, applicant activity, interviews, offers, hires, and onboarding completion.
* Assists with employment verifications, internal and external audits, and other HR records as needed.

**General Human Resources Support**

* Provides daily administrative and operational support to the Director of Human Resources.
* Assists employees with routine Human Resources questions and directs complex employee relations, disciplinary, legal, policy, or compliance matters to the Director of Human Resources.
* Provides backup assistance to the HR Benefits Administrator during periods of increased workload or staff absence.
* Assists with payroll\-related administrative functions as assigned and trained.
* Prepares HR correspondence, reports, forms, spreadsheets, communications, and other documentation.
* Assists with agency audits and compliance reviews.
* Assists in implementing HR policies, procedures, and departmental processes.
* Helps ensure Human Resources policies and practices are applied consistently throughout the organization.
* Participates in HR\-related meetings, training, and agency activities as requested.
* Maintains professional relationships with employees, leadership, candidates, applicants, and external partners.
* Assists in providing services in other programs as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None. This position does not directly supervise employees unless otherwise assigned by the Director of Human Resources or agency leadership.




**Necessary Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstrate a commitment to the vision and mission of the agency.
* Demonstrate compliance with confidentiality and privacy standards as required by the agency and applicable law.
* Demonstrate strong self\-initiative and self\-motivation.
* Demonstrate effective time management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrate excellent customer service and relationship\-building skills.
* Possess strong interviewing, listening, and observational skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with applicants, candidates, employees, supervisors, and leadership.
* Ability to organize and coordinate multiple interviews, vacancies, candidates, deadlines, and onboarding activities simultaneously.
* Ability to evaluate applicant information against established job qualifications.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and statistical data.
* Ability to handle confidential applicant and employee information with discretion.
* Ability to work independently while recognizing when matters should be escalated to the Director of Human Resources.
* Ability to function effectively in a high\-paced and at times stressful environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of the Human Resources and Administration teams.
* Ability to maintain a professional and positive candidate and employee experience.




**Applicant Must:**

* Be 21 years of age, pass a national fingerprint criminal background investigation, and not be listed in any registry of sexual offenders.
* Pass a drug screening.
* Adhere to ALL Pivot and program policies and procedures.
* Demonstrate compliance with confidentiality/privacy standards required by agency and law.
* Demonstrate professional conduct and appearance.
* Be compassionate, respectful, and tolerant of a wide variety of identities and personalities.




**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Organizational Management, Communications, or a related field preferred. A combination of relevant education and progressively responsible human resources, recruitment, staffing, onboarding, or administrative experience may be considered.

**Experience:**

* Two (2\) to three (3\) years of Human Resources, recruitment, talent acquisition, staffing, onboarding, or related administrative experience preferred.
* Experience recruiting, screening, and communicating with job applicants preferred.
* Experience coordinating and/or conducting employment interviews preferred.
* Experience with new\-employee onboarding and orientation preferred.
* Experience working with HRIS, applicant tracking, payroll, or related HR systems preferred. Paycom experience is a plus.
* Experience maintaining confidential applicant and employee information required.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple open positions and competing priorities preferred.


Certificates, Licenses and/or Registrations: Possess a valid Driver's License and current vehicle insurance verification. Professional certification in Human Resources or talent acquisition is preferred but not required.

**Training:** Within 90 Days: Attend New Employee Orientation, Become CPR/First Aid Certified, and complete Managing Aggressive Behaviors (MAB) Certification. Complete understanding of all agency programs and services, and any training needed as deemed appropriate by supervisor(s).

**Continued:**

* Adhere to the agency's confidentiality including HIPAA, Privacy, Corporate Compliance, Code of Ethics, and Conflict of Interest policies and procedures.
* Ensures security of staff files and safe use of organization property, vehicle and materials.
* Must be reliable and dependable.
* Compassionate, respectful and tolerant of a wide variety of personalities and people including clients, their parents, applicants, employees, and co\-workers.
* Ability to confer and consult with other professionals.
* Strong interviewing and observing skills; effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly resourceful team player, with ability to also be extremely effective independently.




**Other:**

* Demonstrate strong self\-initiative and self\-motivation.
* Proficient with MS Office software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and effectively utilize HRIS, applicant tracking, payroll, and other HR systems.
* Ability to work under pressure at times to handle a wide variety of time sensitive tasks.
* Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.




**Essential Functions/Physical Requirements**


Includes bending/carrying/lifting/hand and finger dexterity/kneeling/vision/hearing


Sedentary X Light Medium Heavy Very Heavy \_


Depending on the work assignment, may require ordinary ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; light to medium weights up to 20 pounds. Requires good hand\-eye coordination, and arm, hand, and finger dexterity, including the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, operate equipment, and read technical information. Overall mobility is essential including sitting for long periods of time, driving a vehicle, and working under challenging conditions.




**Work Conditions:** Work is performed indoors with moderate exposure to safety and health hazards related to exposure to infections, communicable diseases, blood and body fluids, electrical equipment, and chemicals, such as alcohol or bleach. No potential for bodily injury related to lifting and incidents of workplace violence. Must follow universal safety precautions.




**Security:** Adheres to the agency's confidentiality policies and procedures including HIPAA, Privacy, Corporate Compliance, Code of Ethics, and Conflict of Interest.




**Supervision Received:** The Recruitment \& Onboarding Specialist is supervised by the Director of Human Resources.




**Work from home options:** Yes with approval by the Director of Human Resources




**Duties/Expectations:** phone calls, email response, recruitment, applicant screening, interviews, scheduling, candidate communications, new\-hire processing, onboarding, orientation, HRIS/data entry, HR administrative support, meetings, special projects, and other duties or projects assigned by the Director of Human Resources.




**Documentation:** documentation and/or a list of completed tasks may be submitted to supervisor as requested.




**Allowable instances:** weather that causes the main campus to be closed to the public, special projects that require uninterrupted time, other instances agreed upon and given permission by supervisor.




**Reasoning:** Continuity of recruitment, hiring, onboarding, Human Resources services, employee support, organizational staffing, and other HR activities are essential to continuing the functions of Pivot

jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager - Client Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Client Onboarding**



CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full\-time · Travel to client sites (\~25–40%)



Compensation: $95,000 – $120,000 base, depending on experience \+ performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.


**About CrelioHealth**



CrelioHealth builds cloud\-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500\+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow — from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory — for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct\-to\-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA\-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.


**The Role**



When a lab signs with CrelioHealth, you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go\-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.


**This is not a sales role.** You carry no quota and you will never cold\-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.


**What You Will DoOwn implementations**


* Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single\-site labs through multi\-location networks — from kickoff through go\-live and handover to support.
* Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
* Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front\-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go\-live on schedule.
* Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go\-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.


**Make clients successful**


* Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
* Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
* Track onboarding health (time\-to\-go\-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.


**Champion the platform**


* Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
* Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
* Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.


**What We Are Looking For (Must\-haves)**


* **4–7 years of project management experience**, with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
* **Healthcare experience is required**; hands\-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
* Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
* Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
* Structured and self\-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
* Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go\-live (any vendor).
* Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
* Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre\-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
* PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go\-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
* Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.


**How We Hire**



We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role\-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take\-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.


**The Fine Print**



CrelioHealth Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.


*The salary range above is a good\-faith estimate for this posting and may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the US.*

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company**

ApprentiScope is the leading workforce\-management platform purpose\-built for Registered Apprenticeship programs, with customers ranging from Fortune 500 companies to state governments. Our core platform replaces labor\-intensive manual processes, enabling these organizations to scale their programs, reduce compliance burden, and generate measurable outcomes. As AI expansion and energy infrastructure modernization make the skilled trades an ever\-increasing national priority, that demand is accelerating, and ApprentiScope is positioned to define the category.

**Role Overview**

Onboarding Specialists own every new customer's journey from signed contract to go\-live. You'll run our largest implementations end to end: building project plans, coordinating data migrations, standing up SSO, and guiding customer IT and security stakeholders through technical rollouts. At the same time, you'll build the scaled onboarding motion for our smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, group training, and self\-serve resources that cut time\-to\-launch without cutting quality. You're our first dedicated onboarding hire, which means you'll inherit a live queue of active implementations and build the system while running it. At go\-live, you hand each customer to a Customer Success Manager who owns the ongoing relationship, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to get every customer to that handoff quickly, configured correctly, and confident in the product. The role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and teaching.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Onboarding \& Implementation*

* Own new customer onboarding from contract signature to go\-live: build the project plan, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on schedule
* Run enterprise implementations end to end: SSO and identity setup (SAML, Microsoft Entra, Okta), data migration, security and IT coordination, and phased rollouts across programs and locations
* Configure each customer's environment around their program structure and compliance requirements, including RAPIDS workflows, coordinating internally on data migration and integrations
* Deliver role\-based training that makes program sponsors, administrators, and field staff self\-sufficient quickly
* Track time\-to\-launch and clear blockers proactively; no project stalls without a named owner and a next step

*Scaled Onboarding*

* Design and run the one\-to\-many motion for smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, live group training, and office hours
* Build the templates, guides, and self\-serve resources that reduce per\-customer onboarding hours every quarter
* Turn what you see in the field into a prioritized friction list for the product team: what should be self\-serve, what should be automated, what confuses customers

*Systems \& Handoffs*

* Define and enforce the go\-live gate: a completion checklist plus a first adoption milestone before any account moves to steady state
* Bring the account's CSM in at kickoff so every customer meets their long\-term owner on day one
* Own onboarding metrics and report them weekly: time\-to\-launch, active project count, go\-live rate, and aging on anything stalled
* Build the onboarding playbook (project templates, milestone plans, training curriculum) as an early member of a growing team

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* 4\+ years in implementation, onboarding, professional services, or technical project management at a B2B SaaS company
* Proven ability to run 10\+ concurrent implementations: multi\-stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery
* Hands\-on experience with technical implementation work: SSO and identity providers (SAML, Entra, Okta), data migration, and integrations, comfortable working directly with customer IT teams
* Experience running enterprise rollouts: security reviews, IT and procurement stakeholders, multi\-month timelines
* Experience building or running one\-to\-many onboarding: cohorts, webinars, templated implementations
* Comfort with data: tracking cycle times and capacity, maintaining CRM hygiene (we run on HubSpot)
* Aptitude for developing deep technical product knowledge (configuration, integrations, workflows) and learning a regulated domain: Registered Apprenticeship compliance
* Training and facilitation skill: can teach a room of field users or a C\-suite sponsor with equal clarity
* Writes documentation other people can actually run: project plans, status updates, playbooks

**Behavioral Traits**

* Structured operator: runs a dozen concurrent projects without letting details slip
* Finisher: allergic to stalled projects; drives every implementation to go\-live and closes every loop
* Builder: documents as they go and turns anything done twice into a template
* Proactive, not reactive: customers and teammates always know the status and the next step
* Boundary\-disciplined: protects the project plan, flags scope creep early, and hands off cleanly instead of holding on
* Composed under pressure: keeps priorities straight when timelines compress and multiple accounts need attention at once
* Intellectually curious: genuinely wants to master a complex, compliance\-driven product and domain

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance (Medical, Vision \& Dental)
* Educational, Bereavement \& Parental leave
* 20 days paid time off
* Work from home stipend

**Compensation**

* Salary Range: $80,000 \- $90,000
* Equity: significant early\-stage stock options

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

* What interests you most about working at ApprentiScope?
* Given your experience \& skills, why do you think you'd be a good fit for this position?

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist (Remote)**
======================================


**Build the System That Launches an Industry**
----------------------------------------------


Nest Veterinary is on track to 5X this year. We're the category leader in care plan infrastructure for veterinary practices — and every new hospital that joins our network goes live because of the work our Implementation team does. If you love building processes, owning outcomes, and making complex launches look effortless, this role was made for you.

**About Nest Veterinary**


Our mission is simple: make pet care accessible to every pet parent. We provide fully\-managed, tech\-enabled care plan solutions that help veterinary practices increase compliance, drive revenue, and deliver better preventive care — without the administrative burden.


We're transforming an industry, and we're doing it with design\-forward products and a team that genuinely cares about the outcome.

**The Role**
------------


As an Implementation Specialist, you're the engine behind every successful hospital launch. You'll orchestrate the onboarding process from kickoff to go\-live — coordinating logistics, validating readiness, and ensuring every technical and operational detail is locked in before launch day.


But this role goes beyond project management. You'll also be a key trainer and coach for the practices you onboard, preparing hospital teams to confidently integrate care plans into their daily offerings. You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Hospital Success Managers to make sure practices don't just go live — they go live ready.


At Nest, implementation isn't a back\-office function. It's one of the most visible, high\-impact roles in the company.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Leadership**


Own the launch. You'll serve as project lead for new hospital onboarding — driving timelines, managing deliverables, and co\-leading rollouts alongside Hospital Success Managers to ensure a seamless, coordinated experience for every practice.

### **Practice Training \& Readiness**


Prepare hospital teams to succeed with care plans from day one. You'll deliver training sessions that equip veterinary staff with the knowledge, confidence, and workflows they need to successfully introduce care plans as part of their practice offerings — making the transition feel natural, not disruptive.

### **Logistics \& Readiness Coordination**


Execute the behind\-the\-scenes work that makes launches run smoothly. You'll manage scheduling, resource allocation, and communication flow; confirm all readiness checkpoints before go\-live; and align internal teams, vendors, and hospital staff so nothing falls through the cracks.

### **Technical Review \& Validation**


Be the checkpoint owner. You'll conduct readiness reviews to verify integrations, configurations, and systems are launch\-ready; coordinate with Engineering, clients, and Support on any outstanding requirements; and document all technical and logistical sign\-offs for a clean handoff.

### **Cross\-Team Collaboration**


Your work doesn't end at launch. You'll partner with Hospital Success Managers throughout the onboarding lifecycle, support a smooth transition to the ongoing support team, and bring post\-launch insights back to Product, Engineering, and Hospital Success to continuously improve the process.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years in SaaS implementation, operations, or project management (veterinary or healthcare experience is a plus)
* Experience training or enabling client\-facing teams — you know how to make complex concepts click
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate logistics across multiple stakeholders and keep projects on track
* Epic organizational skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in fast\-moving environments
* Excellent communicator — clear and confident with both internal teams and hospital staff
* Familiarity with veterinary practice workflows or healthcare systems is a plus
* Startup experience preferred — you're comfortable building as you go and raising your hand when something could be better
* Familiarity with CRM Database workflows

**Why Nest**
------------

* 5X growth trajectory — your work will directly shape how we scale
* High visibility role — every hospital launch has your fingerprints on it
* Mission that matters — more pets getting the preventive care they need because practices are set up to succeed
* Ground\-floor opportunity — help define what great implementation looks like at a category\-leading company
* Teammates who show up — kind, motivated, and genuinely collaborative

*Nest is an equal\-opportunity employer. You are welcome at Nest for who you are, no matter where you come from or what you look like. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. Bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It's in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing veterinary health care and help pets live longer, healthier, and happier lives.*

  

Compensation Range: $75K \- $80K
